name: com.ignidata.api.plugin.SurveyActivity
description: Ignidata Surveys by Andre Teixeira opens a survey requested by the app, loads its questions from Ignidata, records answers, and submits them. It returns completion or cancellation status to apps and Unity games that use the integration.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete Ignidata surveys, and app flows waiting for the survey result cannot finish.
